review: anonymized artifact review with criteria written by separate case author before outputs; second independent review for main implementation
comparability: same case input, tool environment, inherited parent model settings, fresh context, output budget; single-task workers
release_gate: Useful material improvements over the committed skill in more than one type of task, with no unresolved severe regression in the core journey, explicit constraints, or evidence honesty. Qualitative development decision, not statistical superiority. If a defect requires instruction revision, preserve the failed frozen run and use a new held-out case.
known_limits: LLM reviewers rather than real users
Shared filesystem with instructed separation, not security isolation
No per-arm token, cost, or pinned model snapshot exposed
no_external_effects: local artifacts only; no publication, messages, deployment, or paid API by workers
